summary: Frontend-only PWA end-to-end verification passed at 390x844 against the public preview URL. All 12 requested areas verified: home render (greeting, can't sleep?, hero photo loaded with naturalWidth>0, CTA), all 5 lowercase recording cards, play/pause state toggle with featured card title update, waveform animates while playing and settles on pause, exclusive one-at-a-time playback, surprise me, sleep mode overlay with 15/30/60/end chips and working countdown (30m -> 29:59 left), note edit/save with 'saved with love' state, triple-tap coffee cup reveals scrollable 'happy bdayy my goat' overlay (overflowY:auto) and closes, install hint hidden on desktop UA and visible/dismissible/persistent with iPhone Safari UA, all 6 PWA head tags present in live DOM, service worker registered and active, and /manifest.json, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png, /service-worker.js all return HTTP 200.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) in StyleSheet shadow styles, and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' in app/index.tsx BirthdayModal (line 270). Non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN web compatibility.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence react-native-web deprecation warnings.

Known environment limitation (not a bug): headless Chromium cannot decode M4A/AAC so durations show placeholder values (0:18, 0:22, etc.) and no audible playback in tests; play state toggles and waveform animation are the correct signals. Verify audio on a real iPhone/Android during phone-test.
Known non-issue: noscript fallback text 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' (Expo dev shell template) is the only uppercase string in DOM; it is never visible with JS enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: No uppercase visible app copy found; all titles, buttons, and overlays are lowercase as required.
InstallHint storage module resolves via src/utils/storage/index.web.ts (localStorage) - dismiss persistence verified across reload.
All interactive elements have testID attributes; touch targets meet 44px minimum (play 46px, coffee 44px, timer chips 44px, save 44px).
seed_data_creation: None. Note field was edited and restored to DEFAULT_NOTE after save verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully working on the public preview. Playwright verified: play toggles aria-label between 'Play <title>'/'Pause <title>', featured card shows active track title, waveform bars animate (computed transform changes) only while playing, exclusive playback works, sleep timer countdown decrements, birthday overlay scrollable and closable, install hint iOS branch works with persisted dismissal. Service worker status 'active'. PWA tags injected at runtime (dev server shell) - verify in live DOM, not raw HTML.
rca_of_issue: Lowercase check flagged 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' - root cause: default Expo Router dev-shell <noscript> template text, not app code, never rendered when JS is enabled. No fix required.
